Grid schema

RotoGrinders’ projection grid is the artefact its users actually read, so reproducing its shape matters as much as reproducing its numbers. Column headers were transcribed from the live site on 2026-09-22 for MLB, NFL and WNBA only.

The two-way invariant, asserted by tests/test_pipeline.py: every observed column is either mapped to a real RGENGY value or carries a written reason for being null, and every written reason refers to a column that actually exists. A null with no reason is indistinguishable from a bug; a filled column with no source is indistinguishable from a fabrication.

25HnullConsistent with 1B + 2B + 3B + HR on the six public rows, but inferred rather than published, so it is not emitted.
26PARKnullBallpark identifier. RGENGY derives a park FACTOR from observed splits (engines.park_factor_from_splits) rather than shipping a hard-coded park table, and exposes it in extra['park_factor'].
27BASESnullConsistent with 1B + 2*2B + 3*3B + 4*HR on the six public rows, but that is an inference, not a published definition, so it is not emitted.
28OUTSnullZero for hitters on all six public rows and a pitcher statistic; not emitted for hitters rather than guessed.
29BATKnullUnpublished definition; not reproduced.
30HRRBInullUnpublished definition; not reproduced.
31PCnullEmpty on all six public rows; meaning undetermined.
32REFTMnullReference team for a comparison view; a UI affordance rather than a projection.
33REFOPPnullReference opponent for a comparison view; a UI affordance rather than a projection.
34OBFPTSnullRotoGrinders publishes OBFPTS at full float precision, ~1.08-1.13x FPTS, with no published definition (IR-21). Not reproduced.
35WINDweather.wind
36TEMPweather.temp_f
37TEMPDESCweather.desc
38ORDERbatting_order
39UNDERDOGnullA partner-site projection. RotoGrinders does not publish how it differs from FPTS (it does differ on all six rows), so it is not reproduced.
40PRIZEPICKSnullEqualled FPTS exactly on all six public rows, i.e. RotoGrinders' own projection re-published under a partner brand. Not emitted, because RGENGY cannot verify that equivalence holds generally (IR-23).
41FLOORfloor
42CEILceil
43POWNpown
44OPTOnullRotoGrinders' optimiser output. Its objective and constraints are unpublished, so RGENGY emits its own optimiser result separately instead of under this heading.
45SMASHnullUnpublished definition. RGENGY computes its own P(FPTS > 1.5x projection) into extra['smash'] and labels it as its own (IR-21).
46TOPVALnullUnpublished definition; not reproduced.
47TEAMOWNnullTeam-level ownership. RotoGrinders' aggregation is unpublished; RGENGY exposes per-player pOWN only rather than inventing a team roll-up (IR-22).
48DIFFERENCEnullUnpublished definition; not reproduced.
49LEVnullUnpublished definition. RGENGY computes its own value-share-minus-ownership-share into extra['lev'] and labels it as its own (IR-21).
